info.text: Valiant hero, I am honored to grace your presence again!
I am happy to see you have recovered from your injuries.

News of your exploits saving the Autaric Plains has spread throughout the empire! The lords of the Yaloran Empire have ennobled you and request that you journey to Camp Calorn and find out why the Empiric forces there have not been responding. They have asked me to accompany you.
That is...too kind of them. I only did what anyone should do. Why have they bestowed this grace upon me?
Perhaps they are beginning to see what I have seen in you all along.
Come, noble one! Let us make haste to the camp!

info.text: Noble one! These soldiers look to be victims of the infamous Void Magic. Pray to the gods for this not to be the case!
It is a forbidden type of old and dark magic. Even among temple servants, we do not speak of this. Should this magic have found it's way back into the world, we would all  be doomed!
Look out! That is Viscount Remus, a famed Imperial warrior and commander of this camp. It is clear that he is no longer the man he once was.
Are you sure? If he served the Empire faithfully, we should try to save him if possible.
